extracted.name: Pumpkin Mousse-Keto
extracted.description: Trying out some keto friendly dessert ideas for Thanksgiving. This is a keeper in my book. Not too sweet, but sweet enough to full fill my sweet tooth.
ingredient_lines: 2 tbs pumpkin pie spice + extra for garnish
instruction_lines: In a mixing bowl and using a hand blender, mix the cream cheese and unsweetened pumpkin puree together until smooth with no lumps.
Mix in the confectioners erythritol, vanilla and pumpkin pie spice. Mix well.
Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving. Top with the keto whipped cream.
For the whipped topping, put all ingredients in a mixing bowl and whip using a hand mixer until the peak forms to your liking.
Top pumpkin mousse with the whipped topping and sprinkle a little pumpkin spice on top.
